profile.headline: SRE @ Apple
profile.summary: I like to break things, fix things, measure things, and automate myself out of a job.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: - DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering for Services Operations.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Focused on Observability and Performance.

- Consulting with feature teams across Panther to help define their critical signals and build out high level dashboards to quickly identify production incidents and speed up time to resolution.

- Implementing AWS infrastructure and Panther application monitoring using Datadog, Sentry, and Cloudwatch.

- Automating deployment of observability solutions across Panther's single tenant SaaS accounts via Pulumi and Cloudformation.

- Instrumenting Panther application code running in AWS Lambda Functions and ECS Containers with custom metrics and tracing.

positions.title: Lead Member of Technical Staff - Software Engineering
positions.description:
- Helped start Tableau Online's Site Reliability Engineering organization as the first hire for the SRE team.

- Automated the process for executing infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tasks to stand up new Tableau Online infrastructure, reducing the time to deliver a new regional instance of Tableau Online from weeks to hours.

- Developing solutions for observability of Tableau Online services giving insights into the volume, latency, and availability of critical customer facing APIs and functions using Serverless Lambda functions, AWS Kinesis Pipelines, and Apache Kafka.

- Generation of availability data that is used to drive Tableau Online's internal Service Level Objectives and externally facing Service Level Agreements.

- Working with Feature Teams on their Observability strategy to identify and publish the Golden Signals that their services are producing.

- Identifying frequent tasks done manually by our Incident Management Engineers and working cross-team to reduce Operational Toil via automation and changes to the product.

- Acting as an Incident Commander during major incidents impacting Tableau Online.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
-Development of a ChatOps bot to provide engineering staff with a single interface for management of AWS resources, testing infrastructure, scheduled shutdowns, and EC2 instance life cycle workflows.

-Monitoring of production and supporting infrastructure via a mix of Nagios, Icinga, New Relic, and Splunk.

-Development of Chef cookbooks and custom resources to do configuration management in development and production environments.

-Creation of CI/CD pipelines using Concourse CI backed by Git.

-Doing troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and production deployments for the Illumio SaaS platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Conducting deep dive/root cause investigations into performance issues and defects spanning the entire Tableau Server stack and building automated solutions to speed up time to resolution.

-Mentoring Supportability Engagement and Technical Support Engineers on troubleshooting and investigative techniques.

-Development of Logshark, a C# log analysis utility for Tableau Server and Tableau Desktop.

-Development of VizCrawler, a Java load testing and content validation utility for Tableau Server.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
-Responsible for Java and C++ development of multiple high traffic mission critical services
in the Ordering and eCommerce Persistence Platforms groups.

-Development of multi-tenant hosted code services where other areas of the Amazon
business can deploy and execute their custom business logic on top of our SQL and NoSQL
storage services.

-Senior member of one of the first dedicated Site Reliability Engineering/DevOps teams at Amazon. 

-Reducing ticket burden, increasing scalability, and implementing real time diagnostics to help quickly resolve production issues.

-Responsible for maintenance of 99.99% system availability, predictive capacity planning,
configuration management, TCO reduction projects, and production deployments for multiple
mission critical Ordering services.

-Automation of the build and deployment process with no reduction in service availability
through implementation of a continuous deployment pipeline and development of integration
and pre-production test suites.

-Working with and mentoring engineers remotely as part of a 24/7 "follow-the-sun"
relationship with teams in Ireland and India.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
-Responsible for Sales Engineering and product development of Digital Video Recording and Video Management Systems.

-Working with Software Development Engineers on integration with industry standard security cameras and access control systems.

positions.title: Integration Engineer
positions.description:
-Lead Systems Integration Engineer for several large video security and access control installations.

-Responsible for lab testing of new devices to determine field suitability.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
-Technical Support and Software Quality Assurance for Windows and Linux based Digital
Video Recording and Video Management Systems.

-Creation of scripts and tools to automate support tasks and testing.

-Collaboration with Software Development and Support Engineers to solve production issues in the field.
